# HexPiece 3.0.9

Your sea bug with Z. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass.

- **The sea can't touch you while you're light.** The original mod's sea rule (Devil fruit users sink, get weak and slow, and their
  fruit's moves are cut off) counted you as "in the sea" the moment your feet touched the water while the light reflected off it,
  so it ended the light and dragged you down to the sea floor. Now, for as long as you're light (Z, its kick, and the dashes as
  light), the sea rule doesn't apply at all. The light also turns back a little above the water's surface now, so your feet never
  dip in. Once you're a body again, the sea works as before.
